# Conventions

<!-- docsync:auto:begin - generated by docsync, edits inside this block are overwritten -->
> **Section status: CURRENT** - reviewed 2026-11-24; covers 4 files (globs in the front matter).
<!-- docsync:auto:end -->

## Code style
- **Python:**
  - no formatter is configured in the repo; the code follows PEP 8 with 4-space indents;
  - type hints are used throughout;
  - `from __future__ import annotations` is common;
  - module docstrings explain the why;
  - `.ruff_cache` exists, so ruff is used informally on the backend; the Tool Service uses ruff as a verification step for generated code.
- **Python naming:**
  - modules are `snake_case`; one domain package per area (`models.py`, `store.py`, `routes`);
  - layers are named `<Thing>Layer`;
  - private helpers start with `_`;
  - constants are UPPER_CASE.
- **TypeScript:**
  - Prettier with `printWidth 100`, semicolons, double quotes and trailing commas;
  - ESLint flat config (recommended JS and TS, react-hooks, react-refresh; `no-restricted-imports` bans `server-only`; `no-unused-vars` is off);
  - strict TS with `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` and `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`.
- **File naming:**
  - React components are PascalCase `.tsx` in feature folders;
  - hooks are `useX`;
  - routes use TanStack flat dotted names (`agents.$id.tsx`; a trailing `_` breaks nesting);
  - shadcn primitives are kebab-case in `components/ui`.
- **Imports:** the frontend uses the `@/` alias for `src/`. The backend uses absolute `app.` imports.
- **Line endings:** LF (`.gitattributes`).

## Patterns used everywhere
- **Errors to HTTP:**
  - routes raise `HTTPException(status, detail)`;
  - domain errors are mapped in `main.py` (`AuthError` → `{detail, code}` with its status; `WorkspaceKeyMissing` → 409 `code: "workspace_key"`);
  - Tool Service unavailability → 503;
  - start-up steps are each wrapped in try/except and log a warning, so one subsystem never stops boot.
- **Never fatal.** Decision layers, classification and annotation are best effort with safe defaults. Failures are recorded as events, not exceptions.
- **Dependency access:**
  - module-level singletons (`settings`, `tool_resolver`, `runs.manager.manager`, `get_store()`) instead of FastAPI dependency injection;
  - the Mistral client per workspace comes from `dependencies.get_mistral_client()`, using the context-variable workspace.
- **Context variables:** the current workspace, the current execution and step, and the workflow-rules activation flow through contextvars, so step runners work without request objects.
- **Long work:**
  - anything slower than a request becomes a background run (`runs/`), or reports through `X-Op-Id` progress;
  - blocking I/O goes through `asyncio.to_thread`.
- **Pipelines:** a layer does one job, emits events, and calls `next`. Model questions go through `decide()` with a role. Results are Pydantic specs.
- **Stores:** synchronous SQLAlchemy sessions (`SessionLocal()`), short-lived; JSON in Text columns; additive `ensure_schema()`.
- **Frontend data fetching:**
  - TanStack Query with keys from `QK` only;
  - API clients in `src/api/*` return unwrapped data;
  - mutations invalidate by key and show sonner toasts;
  - long actions use `lib/runs` (background runs) or `lib/ops/tracker` (request progress).
- **Frontend composition:** pages in `routes/` compose feature components; write controls are gated with `lib/policy`; empty, loading and error states use `EmptyState`, `Skeletons` and `ErrorState`.

## UI conventions
- **Design system:** shadcn/ui (new-york, slate base, CSS variables) on Radix primitives, with lucide icons.
- **Theming:**
  - every colour is a token in `src/styles.css` (Tailwind v4 CSS-first), with light and dark themes;
  - no raw colours in components;
  - status colours come from `lib/status.ts` (`StatusPill`).
- **Layout:**
  - the app shell has a grouped sidebar (Build, Operate, Knowledge, Integrations, System) and a top header (sidebar toggle, breadcrumb section › page › item);
  - the admin console has its own shell;
  - "glass" styling and GSAP animations appear on the landing page.
- **Copy and tone:**
  - plain-language, outcome-first messages, for example "Waiting for your decision: …" and "Stopped before it finished.";
  - errors say what happened and what to do;
  - terminology comes from `lib/terminology`. Use "Catalog" in the UI even though the code says ontology.
- **Accessibility:** Radix primitives supply focus management and ARIA. Icons in buttons have labels or tooltips. No formal audit is recorded.

## Git and release conventions
- **Branches:** `main` is the default; work happens on `dev-*` branches (currently `dev-2`).
- **Commits:**
  - recent messages are conventional (`feat:`, `fix:`) with a plain-language, outcome-first summary and an explanatory body;
  - older ones are free-form;
  - `frontend-3/AGENTS.md` forbids rewriting published history, because the frontend is connected to Lovable.
- **Versioning:** no tags or semantic releases. The API reports version "2.0.0", fixed in `main.py`.
- **Ignored files:** secrets (`*.secret`, `.env`), databases, generated workflows and uploads are git-ignored and docker-ignored.
- **Replication docs:** `replication/` is kept in step through the docsync pre-commit hook (`replication/_tooling/docsync.py`).
